description: This file defines the setup wizard and configuration logic for the WhatsApp channel integration within the openclaw platform. It manages linking status, account detection, and the finalization process for setting up WhatsApp.

methods.name: resolveShouldPromptAccountIds
methods.description: Determines if the wizard should prompt for account IDs based on the configuration options.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the WhatsApp setup by calling the relevant API with provided configuration, account ID, and runtime context.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the WhatsApp setup channel in the configuration.

methods.name: onAccountRecorded
methods.description: Callback invoked when an account ID is recorded, to perform additional actions such as notifying other components.
